integrity: All public claims rely on a self-contained exact proof; a reproducible finite matrix checker is supplementary. Primary full text inspected. No claim of independent audit or independent authorship.
scientific_limitations: Finite cyclic group of order \(N=pm\), full subgroup of p translations, distinct interlaced p-th-root characters, and an arbitrary subset of modulations. The theorem does not cover arbitrary nonrectangular time-frequency erasures or other windows. It refines but does not replace the general block-equivalence theorem of Asipchuk–De Carli–Rodriguez.
title: Complete spectral and dual classification of interlaced-character Gabor sampling masks
